name: Scale-Shelter Wrecks
introDiscord:
Shipwrecks lie beneath enormous shed scales that protected them from
the worst currents for centuries.

Scale-Shelter Hermits had the same idea.
introTwitch:
Shipwrecks lie beneath enormous shed scales that protected them from
the worst currents for centuries.

Scale-Shelter Hermits had the same idea.

scale-shelter-wrecks-approach.prompt:
Three wreck-lined routes pass beneath overlapping Leviathan scales,
each broad enough to serve as a roof.

left.message:
A Scale-Shelter Hermit emerges carrying a fragment of Leviathan scale
as its shell.

Shizuki would later describe this as:

'ambitious housing.'

right.message:
One Berry rests beneath Shizuki's abandoned shelter.

Her note:

'Found perfect roof.

Roof is scale.

Glimmer keeps reminding me.

I KNOW.'

forward.message: A wrecked strongbox survived beneath the overlapping scale.

scale-shelter-wrecks-depths.prompt: Three routes weave through ships crushed beneath the armored remains.

left.message:
A mineral pool collects beneath a tilted scale.

Shizuki scratched:

'Scale umbrella.

Zero rain.

Still useful.'
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the scale umbrella and restorative water undisturbed.

right.message:
A Hermit crawls from beneath a wreck wearing a polished scale fragment
like extremely expensive armor.

forward.message: Star Candies are trapped beneath the edge of an immense scale.

scale-shelter-wrecks-threshold.prompt:
Armored Drift is layered in enough Leviathan scales to resemble a
second seabed.

left.message: A navigator's chest lies beneath one overlapping plate.

right.message:
Shizuki's old bottle sits in a shelter labeled:

'Scale Fort.

Population:
Shizuki.
Glimmer.
One crab who was evicted.'
right.fullHpMessage: You leave Fort Scale's medical inventory untouched.

forward.message:
A Scale-Shelter Hermit blocks the path wearing enough armor to qualify
as a small bunker.

boss-antechamber.name: Armored Drift
boss-antechamber.prompt: Several enormous scale fragments begin moving.

bossPromptDiscord:
Several enormous scale fragments begin moving.

At first you assume the current shifted them.

Then legs appear underneath.

Use /yes to approach Armored Drift or /no to respect the mobile fortress.
bossPromptTwitch:
Several enormous scale fragments begin moving.

At first you assume the current shifted them.

Then legs appear underneath.

Use !yes to approach Armored Drift or !no to respect the mobile fortress.
bossRetreatText:
You back away.

The armored mound settles again.

boss.revealText:
A colossal Hermit rises beneath a full Leviathan scale.

Titan-Scale Hermit reveals itself!

completionText:
The Titan-Scale Hermit retreats into the wrecks.

You now know one Leviathan scale can double as a house.

Useful information.

Probably.
